name: R01 Freight Revenue by Business Unit

statements:
SELECT
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START),
  COMMODITIES.BUSINESS_UNIT,
  SUM(FREIGHT_REVENUE.TOTAL_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_REVENUE.CARLOADS)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.COMMODITIES  COMMODITIES,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_CALENDAR  FISCAL_CALENDAR,
  CNR_FIN.FREIGHT_REVENUE  FREIGHT_REVENUE
WHERE
  ( FREIGHT_REVENUE.COMMODITY_CODE=COMMODITIES.COMMODITY_CODE  )
  AND  ( FREIGHT_REVENUE.PERIOD_START=FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START),
  COMMODITIES.BUSINESS_UNIT

variables.name: Segment Code
variables.formula: =If([Business Unit]="Coal") Then "BLK" ElseIf([Business Unit]="Intermodal") Then "INT" Else "MER"
